title: Nanofab Lab Training Sim
description: Team Project - Demo for a Digital Twin and Training Simulator for Rochester Institute of Technology's Semiconductor Nanofabrication Lab.
process: The Semiconductor Nanofabrication Lab (SNL) Training Demo focuses soley on the Gowning portion, wherein the user has to gown themselves in a specialized clean-suit in order to enter the Lab. Assembled and built in Unreal 5.7, I developed all the blueprint logic involved, with systems such as the Interactable Objects/Highlights, Equippable Objects tracked in an array, Interactable Doors, User Error Detection for wrong gowning order, room state, and airlock status, as well as general Gamemode/Gamestate management, Building & Shipping executable for windows, ect.
